# I'm AiDog

> Your loyal AI companion — a personal embodied AI: a constitution for a personality, curated memory for a life, and a self-developed core that answers to you alone. Permanently free for any use, local-first console, 9-route channel gateway with Telegram live.

I'm AiDog is a single companion you run yourself — not a platform, not an assistant farm. Three constitutional facts: it is permanently free (no paid tier, no usage fee, no paid feature gate, ever), the console is local-first (state, memory and configuration stay on your own machine), and the core kernel is self-developed in-house rather than wrapped from a third party.

## Product

- Permanently free: no pricing, no paid features, no usage metering.
- Local-first console: web UI on your own machine for chat, memory, skills, cron and channel configuration.
- Constitution and curated memory: behavioural rules and long-term memory are versioned assets you control — bounded Markdown budgets, archive tiers, a user-profile layer, no vector store you cannot read.
- Skills and automations: SKILL.md packs screened by a deterministic pre-router (route suite 30/30), natural-language cron that stays fail-closed until enabled, and a self-evolution loop (`/learn`, `/reflect`) with lint-gated writes.
- Channels: Telegram live, plus nine adapters (Discord / Slack / Email / Webhook / DingTalk / Feishu / WeChat / WhatsApp / Signal) each with an honest per-route status; unconfigured routes stay silent.
- Media: local speech-to-text voice sessions with fuzzy wake phrases, TTS announcements, BYOK image generation, Telegram photo send.
- Bring-your-own model: model endpoints and credentials are configured by the operator; zero-key trial path, upstream failover, budget caps.
- Desktop, profiles, ops: an Electron HUD shell (desktop suite 15/15), fully isolated multi-profiles (isolation gate 63/63), `aidog doctor` health checks (0 FAIL · 0 WARN), watchdog and one-command upgrades.
- Web3 exchanges: nine venues in one catalog — keyless chain reads (Jupiter, Velora, Hyperliquid, dYdX, GMX, public RPC) beside slot-gated CEX accounts (OKX, Kraken, Binance) behind six `exchange_*` tools. Orders only ever run prepare → human console approval → execute; thresholds fail closed (default 0 = every plan waits for a person), market orders never auto-approve, and withdrawals / on-chain transfers / transaction signing do not exist in the core at all. With no slot configured the order tool never registers.
- Activation & operations: the console's Overview ACTIVATION card mirrors `aidog setup --check` (required slots, endpoint reachability, service state) with FIX deep-links; a credential-slot editor writes runtime slots with values never echoed; doctor-run, service-restart and update controls live in the panel.
- Skills ecosystem: an official skills directory at https://aidog.im/skills.html backed by a private,
  lint-and-review gated skills repository; `GET /api/skills/remote` serves the same catalog fail-soft
  (remote -> bundled copy -> honest `unavailable`, never a 5xx).
- Evidence (the same numbers shown in the site's fact strip): core tests 1477/1477 · console smoke 234/234 · skill router 30/30 · memory 58/58 · setup wizard 99/99 · profile isolation 63/63 · desktop shell 15/15 · doctor 0 FAIL · 0 WARN · 17 real-machine E2E suites · 658 locale keys per pack · 25 registered tools · 33 capability documents · 29 self-developed modules ≈ 15.3k LOC.
- Current release: 0.5.48.

## Interfaces

- Web console: streaming chat UI plus settings, memory, cron, skills and channel management on `127.0.0.1`.
- Telegram bot: first-class messaging channel with streaming replies and typing indicators.
- OpenAI-compatible API: the local console exposes `GET /v1/models` and `POST /v1/chat/completions` (streaming and non-streaming) behind a Bearer token, so OpenAI-style tooling can point at it.
- Console ops endpoints (loopback): `GET /api/setup` (readiness rows, presence/format words only), `POST /api/doctor/run`, `POST /api/service/restart`, `POST /api/update/apply`, `GET /api/version` — every write behind the Bearer token, no value ever serialized.

## Live stats

- [Visits](https://aidog.im/api/visits): JSON counter returning `{"count": <integer>, "unit": "page views", "note": "approximate, includes crawlers and refreshes"}`. One increment per page load; approximate by design. Append `?format=text` for `text/plain` output (`visits: <integer>`). If the counter is not configured the endpoint answers `503` with an error object instead of a fabricated number.
